records.jp: んー！<CR>この辺りは木陰もあって涼しいね
records.en_original: This should be a good spot. Nice and cool with all the shade.
records.en: This should be a good spot.<CR>Nice and cool with all the shade.

records.jp: きらら？
records.en_original: Kirara?

records.jp: ……声がする
records.en_original: I...hear a voice.

records.jp: えっ！？
records.en_original: Really?!

records.jp: それって、神様の声？
records.en_original: Is it the Divine?

records.jp: 違う……<CR>これは内なる声
records.en_original: No... This voice is from somewhere inside.

records.jp: 深い闇の中から、聞こえてくる……
records.en_original: Somewhere deep and dark...
records.en: It comes from deep within the darkness...

records.jp: まさか、その井戸から……？
records.en_original: You mean like from that well?
records.en: You mean like from that well?

records.jp: ど、どこから……？
records.en_original: F-from where...?

records.jp: この辺り……<CR>小さいけど、確かに聞こえる
records.en_original: It's close... It's faint, but I'm certain I can hear it.
records.en: Around here...<CR>It is faint, but Kirara can definitely hear it.

records.jp: （きららの視線の先って……あの井戸だよね？）
records.en_original: (She's...looking over at that well...)

records.jp: たしかに、この井戸……<CR>前から気になってたんだよ
records.en_original: Hmm, this well has been bothering me for a while.
records.en: This well... has been bothering<CR>me for a while too.

records.jp: 井戸って言えば、<CR>ホラーではお約束のシチュだし
records.en_original: Wells are a like, a total staple of horror films, right?
records.en: A well is a classic<CR>situation in horror.

records.jp: この井戸にも何かいるのかな？<CR>ねえ、きらら。どんな声がすんの？
records.en_original: You don't think there's anything inside, do you? What kind of voice are you hearing?
records.en: Could there be something in this well too?<CR>Kirara, what kind of voice is it?

records.jp: ……悲しみ
records.en_original: A sad one.

records.jp: えっ、悲しみ？
records.en_original: A-a sad one?

records.jp: そして、絶望……
records.en_original: Filled with despair.

records.jp: うわー……<CR>悲しみと絶望って、やばくない？
records.en_original: Uh oh. That sounds pretty bad...

records.jp: うん。早く何とかしないと、<CR>ここから動けなくなる
records.en_original: Yes. We must do something soon, lest it paralyze me.
records.en: Yes. Unless Kirara does something soon,<CR>she will be unable to move from here.

records.jp: ええっ！？
records.en_original: What?!

records.jp: それ、まずいよ！<CR>すぐに、逃げなきゃ！
records.en_original: This sounds bad, Kirara! Let's get outta here!
records.en: This sounds bad, Kirara!<CR>Let's get outta here!

records.jp: えっ、何をするの
records.en_original: What are you doing?

records.jp: 何って、きららを抱えて逃げようかなって
records.en_original: Isn't it obvious? I'm carrying you out of here!
records.en: I'm going to carry Kirara and run away.

records.jp: なんで？
records.en_original: Why?

records.jp: だって、ここにいたらヤバいんでしょ？<CR>だから……
records.en_original: You said it might be dangerous, right? So...
records.en: Because staying here is dangerous, right?<CR>So...

records.jp: そうだ！　成仏させてあげよう！
records.en_original: I know! I bet we have to help it pass on!
records.en: I know! Let's help it pass on!

records.jp: 成仏？　何を？
records.en_original: Help pass what on?

records.jp: 何って、その声の元凶を！
records.en_original: What do you mean what? That voice!
records.en: What do you mean what? That voice!

records.jp: ……愛央は時々、意味不明なことを言う
records.en_original: You sure are strange...
records.en: Ao says things that make no sense sometimes.

records.jp: いや、成仏すなわち極楽と考えれば<CR>あながち間違っていないのかも？
records.en_original: Unless by pass on you mean to make the voice a thing of the past by satisfying it... That could work.
records.en: But if passing on means reaching paradise,<CR>perhaps it is not entirely wrong?

records.jp: はあ……？
records.en_original: Uhh...?

records.jp: 何、今の音
records.en_original: What was that sound?

records.jp: きららのお腹の音
records.en_original: My stomach growling.

records.jp: ……もしかして。<CR>声が聞こえるってお腹の音のこと？
records.en_original: Wait a sec. The voice was just your tummy rumbling?
records.en: Wait...<CR>When you said you heard a voice, you meant your stomach?

records.jp: うむ。さっきから、空腹を訴えてくる。<CR>井戸見てたら、ドーナツ食べたくなった
records.en_original: Yes. It has been pestering me ever since I saw that well. Its shape reminded it of a donut.
records.en: Indeed. It has been complaining of hunger for some time.<CR>Looking at the well made Kirara want a donut.

records.jp: もう、なんだよー！<CR>てっきりオバケの類だと思ったのに！
records.en_original: Aw, come on! I totally thought it was some kinda ghost!
records.en: Aw,<CR>come on! I totally thought it was some kinda ghost!

records.jp: オバケ……<CR>きらら、愛央のこと怖がらせた？
records.en_original: A ghost... Did I scare you, Ao?
records.en: A ghost...<CR>Did Kirara frighten you, Ao?

records.jp: まさか、その逆！　ついに自分で<CR>体験できるのかって、期待しちゃった
records.en_original: The opposite! I was excited to see some real life paranormal activity! Talk about disappointing.
records.en: The opposite!<CR>I got excited that I might finally experience one for myself.

records.jp: 私、洒落怖とかめっちゃ好きだからさー
records.en_original: I'm super into no sleep stories.
records.en: I'm really into stories that are too scary to joke about.

records.jp: しゃれこわ？
records.en_original: What's that?

records.jp: ああ、洒落にならないぐらい怖い話のこと。<CR>何か話してあげよっか？
records.en_original: They're horror stories that are so scary you'll never sleep again! How about I tell you one now?
records.en: Yeah, stories so frightening they're no joke.<CR>Want me to tell you one?

records.jp: うん。ドーナツの話ある？
records.en_original: Okay. Are any of them about donuts?
records.en: Yes. Is there one about donuts?

records.jp: そこは、井戸じゃないんだ……
records.en_original: You do have a one-track mind sometimes...
records.en: So you don't want one about a well...

records.jp: うん、もうめちゃくちゃ怖かった！
records.en_original: Yes! I was freaking out.

records.jp: ……それは、ごめん
records.en_original: ...My apologies.

records.jp: 謝ってもダメ。<CR>今もまだ怖いんだから！
records.en_original: A simple apology won't fix things! I'm still shaking over here!
records.en: An apology isn't enough.<CR>I'm still scared!

records.jp: えと、じゃあ……
records.en_original: In that case...

records.jp: 怖いの怖いの、とんでいけー
records.en_original: Do not be scared little one.

records.jp: どう？
records.en_original: How about now?

records.jp: ふっ……あはは！　何、今の！
records.en_original: Pff... Ahaha! What the heck was that?
records.en: Pff... Ahaha! What the heck was that?

records.jp: 笑った……<CR>怖いのなくなった？
records.en_original: You laughed. Do you feel better?

records.jp: うん、ありがと！
records.en_original: Yeah. Thanks.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
